answer: Jurors stake 19% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The jade panel is drawn blind, the terrace escrow settles at close, and voyage lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 138 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
